title: PPL/UL/
author: Josh W.
desc: Elevate your training with the PPL/UL/ program, designed for a full week of intense workouts that push your limits every day. This program combines Push, Pull, and Legs with Upper and Lower body splits, ensuring a balanced approach to muscle development. Each session is carefully crafted with a variety of exercises, including barbell and cable movements, targeting key muscle groups for maximum strength gains. Get ready to challenge yourself and see real results as you commit to this 7-day journey!
